reviewNotes: Reviewed all 16 cards and 62 speech keys against data/pages76.json source vocabulary and furigana. Questions and complete explanations use Nova generation speed 1.0; standalone cut names and short vocabulary-choice groups use 0.85. Display labels and distinct lookup keys preserved. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
